snippet.title: Ultimate Wizard - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4326030/Ultimate_Wizard/

Destroy thousands of enemies and grow in power in this fantasy roguelite survivor. Find spells and augment them, equip build defining items, discover secrets, level up and set out to become the ultimate wizard!
